purpose: Freeze the theory/numerical model before any real CMB likelihood is inspected.

physics.eta: only new inference amplitude; no post-data retuning of KB, tauH0, p, or lambda

observable_scope.forecast_covariance: full-sky cosmic-variance covariance used only for pre-data certification
observable_scope.real_data_policy: real likelihood must use the likelihood's own covariance/data model; forecast CV metric is not reused as a data likelihood

nuisance_cosmology.finite_difference_policy: locked to pre-data implementation; D2/D5 observable-specific robustness already certified
nuisance_cosmology.global_refit_policy: retain residual multistart spread transparently; do not tune solver or gates after freeze

pre_data_certification.interpretation: all four nonlinear baseline refits are below 5 sigma in the pre-data CV metric, but residual basin dependence remains and is frozen rather than tuned away

real_data_sequence: Planck 2018 nuisance-marginalized high-l TTTEEE likelihood plus low-l TT/EE
report eta posterior, Delta chi2, and eta/sigma_eta without retuning frozen physics
only after Planck result, perform independent ACT/SPT confirmation if technically feasible
anti_tuning_rule: After this freeze, no change to KB, tauH0, p, lambda, CLASS commit, patch chain, ell range, or six-parameter cosmology definition may be motivated by the observed real-data preference for eta. Any necessary technical change must be documented as a new provenance event before re-reading the data result.
